droid-monkey attacked this Android app with a real-world fault and it failed. Fix the root cause.

## What happened
Attack `network_loss` (network_loss): Drop the network, then trigger the screen's submit or slow action; the app must not crash or go silent.
Steps: [{"fill": true}, {"fault": "network_off"}, {"tap": "place_order"}, {"settle": 5.3}]
Result: crashed: java.io.IOException: Unable to reach orders.monkeymart.example: no network
Crash: java.io.IOException @ com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.OrderRepository.submit(OrderRepository.kt:27)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.OrderRepository.submit(OrderRepository.kt:27)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutViewModel$placeOrder$1.invokeSuspend(CheckoutViewModel.kt:32)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutViewModel.placeOrder(CheckoutViewModel.kt:31)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutScreenKt.CheckoutScreen$lambda$20$lambda$18$lambda$17(CheckoutScreen.kt:77)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutScreenKt$$ExternalSyntheticLambda9.invoke(D8$$SyntheticClass:0)

## Diagnosis
Root cause: OrderRepository.submit throws IOException when there is no active internet capability (OrderRepository.kt:27). CheckoutViewModel.placeOrder sets placing=true (CheckoutViewModel.kt:30) and calls orders.submit inside viewModelScope.launch with no try/catch (CheckoutViewModel.kt:31-32), so the exception escapes the coroutine and kills the app. Even if it were caught, placing=false (line 33) is skipped, so the button would stay in its spinner state with no error shown. The ViewModel treats a recoverable connectivity failure as fatal.
Fix approach: In CheckoutViewModel, wrap the submit call in try/catch(IOException) inside viewModelScope.launch, and reset placing in a finally block. Expose the failure as an observable error state (for example, `var error: String?`) that the form renders as a message, with the Place order button re-enabled so the user can retry once the network returns. Do not rethrow, and do not let the exception leave the coroutine.
Evidence: app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/data/OrderRepository.kt:27 - throws IOException when isOnline() is false, with no retry or fallback; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/data/OrderRepository.kt:32-35 - isOnline checks the active network's INTERNET capability; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutViewModel.kt:30 - placing is set to true before the network call; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutViewModel.kt:31-32 - viewModelScope.launch calls orders.submit with no try/catch, so the IOException is uncaught; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutViewModel.kt:33 - placing=false is only reached on success, so a failure leaves the spinner stuck; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutScreen.kt:77 - the Place order onClick invokes vm.placeOrder directly with no error handling; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutScreen.kt:81 - the button shows the placing spinner whenever vm.placing is true, so a stuck flag is visible to the user

## Files to change
- app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutViewModel.kt
- app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutScreen.kt

## Regression test
Add a JVM unit test class CheckoutViewModelTest in src/test. Extract an interface for OrderRepository (or inject a fake submit function) so the test can supply a submit that throws java.io.IOException. Call placeOrder, advance the dispatcher with Dispatchers.setMain(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()), and assert that the test does not crash, that placing == false, orderId == null, and error is non-null. Before the fix the test fails with the uncaught IOException and placing stays true.

## Rules
- Fix the root cause in the files above with the idiomatic Android approach. Keep the change small and focused.
- Add exactly one regression test file under app/src/test (JVM unit test, preferred) or app/src/androidTest
  (instrumented), using only test libraries the project already has (see app/build.gradle.kts). It must fail on
  the old code and pass on the fixed code.
- Do not change build files or add dependencies. Do not touch unrelated code. Do not commit.
- When done, reply with one short paragraph: what you changed and the test class name.

22	
23	    private val connectivity = context.applicationContext.getSystemService(ConnectivityManager::class.java)

25	    /** Places the order and returns its id. */
26	    suspend fun submit(order: OrderRequest): String {
27	        if (!isOnline()) throw IOException("Unable to reach orders.monkeymart.example: no network")
28	        delay(1_500)
29	        return "MM-%06d".format(Random.nextInt(1_000_000))
30	    }
31	
32	    private fun isOnline(): Boolean {
33	        val caps = connectivity.getNetworkCapabilities(connectivity.activeNetwork) ?: return false
34	        return caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET)

package com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.rememberScrollState
import androidx.compose.foundation.text.KeyboardOptions
import androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll
import androidx.compose.material3.Button
import androidx.compose.material3.Card
import androidx.compose.material3.CircularProgressIndicator
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.testTag
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.KeyboardType
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.lifecycle.viewmodel.compose.viewModel
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.OrderRepository
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.ProductRepository
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.priceLabel

@Composable
fun CheckoutScreen(
    productId: Int,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    vm: CheckoutViewModel = viewModel(),
) {
    val product = ProductRepository.cached(productId)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val orders = remember { OrderRepository(context) }

    val placedId = vm.orderId
    if (placedId != null) {
        Column(modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp).testTag("order_confirmed"), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Text("Order placed 🎉", style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)
            Text("Order $placedId is on its way to ${vm.city}.", modifier = Modifier.testTag("order_id"))
        }
        return
    }

    Column(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
            .padding(16.dp)
            .testTag("checkout_screen"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
        if (product != null) {
            Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                Row(Modifier.padding(16.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
                    Text("${product.emoji} ${product.name}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                    Text(product.priceLabel(), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.testTag("checkout_total"))
                }
            }
        }

        Text("Delivery details", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
        CheckoutField("Full name", vm.name, { vm.name = it }, "field_name")
        CheckoutField("Email", vm.email, { vm.email = it }, "field_email", KeyboardType.Email)
        CheckoutField("Phone", vm.phone, { vm.phone = it }, "field_phone", KeyboardType.Phone)
        CheckoutField("Address", vm.address, { vm.address = it }, "field_address")
        CheckoutField("City", vm.city, { vm.city = it }, "field_city")
        CheckoutField("Pincode", vm.pincode, { vm.pincode = it }, "field_pincode", KeyboardType.Number)

        ScanCouponButton()

        Button(
            onClick = { vm.placeOrder(orders, productId) },
            enabled = vm.isComplete && !vm.placing,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("place_order"),
        ) {
            if (vm.placing) CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.testTag("placing_order")) else Text("Place order")
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CheckoutField(
    label: String,
    value: String,
    onChange: (String) -> Unit,
    tag: String,
    keyboard: KeyboardType = KeyboardType.Text,
) {
    OutlinedTextField(
        value = value,
        onValueChange = onChange,
        label = { Text(label) },
        singleLine = true,
        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = keyboard),
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag(tag),
    )

package com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.rememberScrollState
import androidx.compose.foundation.text.KeyboardOptions
import androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll
import androidx.compose.material3.Button
import androidx.compose.material3.Card
import androidx.compose.material3.CircularProgressIndicator
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.testTag
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.KeyboardType
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.lifecycle.viewmodel.compose.viewModel
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.OrderRepository
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.ProductRepository
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.priceLabel

@Composable
fun CheckoutScreen(
    productId: Int,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    vm: CheckoutViewModel = viewModel(),
) {
    val product = ProductRepository.cached(productId)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val orders = remember { OrderRepository(context) }

    val placedId = vm.orderId
    if (placedId != null) {
        Column(modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp).testTag("order_confirmed"), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Text("Order placed 🎉", style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)
            Text("Order $placedId is on its way to ${vm.city}.", modifier = Modifier.testTag("order_id"))
        }
        return
    }

    Column(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
            .padding(16.dp)
            .testTag("checkout_screen"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
        if (product != null) {
            Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                Row(Modifier.padding(16.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
                    Text("${product.emoji} ${product.name}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                    Text(product.priceLabel(), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.testTag("checkout_total"))
                }
            }
        }

        Text("Delivery details", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
        CheckoutField("Full name", vm.name, { vm.name = it }, "field_name")
        CheckoutField("Email", vm.email, { vm.email = it }, "field_email", KeyboardType.Email)
        CheckoutField("Phone", vm.phone, { vm.phone = it }, "field_phone", KeyboardType.Phone)
        CheckoutField("Address", vm.address, { vm.address = it }, "field_address")
        CheckoutField("City", vm.city, { vm.city = it }, "field_city")
        CheckoutField("Pincode", vm.pincode, { vm.pincode = it }, "field_pincode", KeyboardType.Number)

        ScanCouponButton()

        Button(
            onClick = { vm.placeOrder(orders, productId) },
            enabled = vm.isComplete && !vm.placing,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("place_order"),
        ) {
            if (vm.placing) CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.testTag("placing_order")) else Text("Place order")
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CheckoutField(
    label: String,
    value: String,
    onChange: (String) -> Unit,
    tag: String,
    keyboard: KeyboardType = KeyboardType.Text,
) {
    OutlinedTextField(
        value = value,
        onValueChange = onChange,
        label = { Text(label) },
        singleLine = true,
        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = keyboard),
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag(tag),
    )
}

`CheckoutViewModel.placeOrder` now catches the `IOException` and no longer crashes. I haven't compiled it or run the tests, so neither is verified.

- **ViewModel:** `placeOrder` catches `IOException` and sets a new observable `error` message. It resets `placing` in a `finally` block, so the spinner no longer sticks. It also clears `error` at the start of each attempt, so retrying works.
- **Signature change:** `placeOrder` now takes `(productId, submit: suspend (OrderRequest) -> String)` instead of an `OrderRepository`, so tests can pass a fake.
- **Test scope:** the ViewModel takes an optional `CoroutineScope` that defaults to `viewModelScope`.
- **Screen:** `CheckoutScreen` shows the error text above the button (tag `order_error`). The button is enabled again as soon as `placing` clears, so the user can retry. It passes `orders::submit` to `placeOrder`.
- **Test class:** `CheckoutViewModelTest` in `app/src/test`. One test checks that a failing submit leaves `placing == false`, `orderId == null` and `error != null`. A second checks that a retry after a failure succeeds.

I didn't use `Dispatchers.setMain(UnconfinedTestDispatcher())` as suggested, because `kotlinx-coroutines-test` isn't a project dependency and I wasn't allowed to add one. The test passes a scope on `Dispatchers.Unconfined` into the ViewModel instead.
